rationale: C25 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It uses the same 1954 Code provision, reproduces essentially the same statutory definition, follows the identical recital-to-finding sequence, addresses multiple specifically listed drugs, and concludes with virtually the same operative proclamation. C23 is also extremely close but is framed for one drug; C06 has the same multi-drug machinery and operative language but cites the predecessor Code provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: OPIATE.—The word "opiate"... shall mean any drug... found by the Secretary or his delegate, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas section 4731 (g) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 provides in part as follows: Opiate. The word "opiate"... shall mean any drug... found by the Secretary or his delegate, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President...
shared_material.explanation: The child and C25 invoke the same statutory subsection and reproduce substantially identical defining language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: AND Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.parent_excerpt: AND Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following-named drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive recital is essentially verbatim and performs the same function immediately before a list of newly designated drugs.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs has an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.
